evidence_items.locator: The Broken Economics of a 100MW Data center, interest-only grace-period paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt: Your bank, in its eternal generosity, offered you a deal — a 12-month-long grace period where you’re only paying interest…which works out to around $168 million, which brings our total costs (excluding the month of delay for fairness) for the first year to around $1.005 billion…on $1.06 billion of revenue.

evidence_items.explanation: This records the inputs, not independent confirmation. Evaluator arithmetic reproduces 5.19% using the rounded totals; retaining the earlier $837.4 million cost subtotal gives 5.15%.

metric_scope.company: Hypothetical operator of a 100 MW AI data center
metric_scope.units: percent; USD millions for calculation inputs

inputs: Earlier annual cost subtotal: USD 837.4 million.
derived.rounding: Percentages rounded to two decimal places: 5.19% and 5.15%.

evidence_items.locator: The Broken Economics of a 100MW Data center, depreciation paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt: That’s $837.4 million a year, leaving you with around $168.6 million in yearly profit, or around a 16.7% gross margin…

evidence_items.explanation: The published cost subtotal includes depreciation. Independent evaluator arithmetic reproduces roughly −40% only when full loan payments are also subtracted; this does not establish a conventional gross margin.

metric_scope.company: Hypothetical operator of a 100 MW AI data center
metric_scope.metric: Modeled annual residual after depreciation and full debt service
metric_scope.units: percent; USD millions for calculation inputs

inputs: Annual interest rate: 6%; assumed monthly rate: 0.005.
Repayment term after grace period: 60 months.
Annual costs including depreciation: USD 837.4 million.
Annual costs before depreciation: USD 316.4 million.
derived.formula: Monthly payment = 2800*0.005/(1-(1.005)^(-60)) = 54.131844 million. Annual payments = 649.582131 million. Stated-method residual = 100*(1060-837.4-649.582131)/1060 = -40.281333%. Removing depreciation from that cash calculation gives 100*(1060-316.4-649.582131)/1060 = 8.869610%, before other cash uses.
derived.rounding: Monthly payment: USD 54.1 million. Annual payment: USD 649.6 million. Residual percentages: −40.28% and 8.87%.
